t: A grades 6 to 12 lesson where students code interactive art in the p5.js editor.
steps: Find the lesson on the Code Savvy site.
Request the lesson plan through the Google Form.
Open the p5.js editor in a browser.
Try a simple shape to test it.
Check whether students need a p5.js account to save work.
Plan how students will save and share their art.
Run the lesson and display the finished pieces.
